summary: Defy structural fatigue. A dense, concentrated cream that targets the micro-circulation around the orbital bone to reduce dark circles and puffiness.
description: Targeted dermal support. This advanced formula utilizes biomimetic peptides to stimulate collagen production, reinforcing the delicate, thin skin under the eyes against environmental and structural stressors.
technical_overview: Offered at $45.0 for 15ml, this KoColor EYE_CARE is expertly formulated with Matrixyl 3000, Caffeine, and Squalane. It delivers a high-fidelity Cream White color profile (`#FDF5E6`) and leverages micro-vascular constriction technology.

dynamic_attributes.label: Usage Notes
dynamic_attributes.body: Gently tap a grain-sized amount along the orbital bone using the ring finger.

dynamic_attributes.label: Expert Tip
dynamic_attributes.body: Store in a cosmetic refrigerator; the cold temperature dramatically boosts the vasoconstricting effects of the caffeine.

dynamic_attributes.label: Formulation Insight
dynamic_attributes.body: Caffeine is encapsulated in liposomes to ensure deep penetration past the stratum corneum.
